definitions.dust: day with a Storm Events Dust Storm/Dust Devil, an NWS Dust Storm Warning/Dust Advisory/Blowing Dust Warning/Advisory covering a zone overlapping the county (zone->county by historical UGC polygon overlap >= 5% of zone area), or any EPA AQS PM10 monitor in the county with 24-h mean > 150 ug/m3 (Jan 1 and Jul 4-5 excluded for PM10-only: fireworks)
definitions.dust_rain: dust day with rain (>= 0.1 in at any of up to 4 GHCN-Daily stations in the county, or a Storm Events Heavy Rain/Flash Flood) on the same day or within the next 3 days (72 h)
definitions.wind: Storm Events High Wind (any), Strong Wind or Thunderstorm Wind with magnitude >= 43.4 kt (50 mph), or an NWS High Wind Warning
definitions.trigger_days_yr: mean days/yr with any of dust, dust_rain, wind, hail (a day counts once)
definitions.monthly_trigger_profile: mean trigger days per calendar month (Jan..Dec), full years only
definitions.*_yr: mean per year over 2015-2025; years{} also holds partial 2026
definitions.caveat: Zone-based events/warnings are assigned to every county the zone overlaps; PM10 > 150 can also be wildfire smoke or local construction; warnings are forecasts, not observations
